steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each client's filings are placed by their deadline in the year.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Deadline with no rule
findings.fix: Name the rule that sets the deadline

outcome.notChecked: The current text of each law.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] filing-rules.md:12  Deadline with no rule.
       Fix: Name the rule that sets the deadline.
[medium] client-a-filings.md:19  Filing with no source.
       Fix: Cite the regulation.
[low] owners.csv:26  Client with no filing owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner.
Not checked: The current text of each law.
pros: Checks a filing with no source, a deadline with no rule, and a client with no filing owner.
cons: Not checked: The current text of each law.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-statutory-filing-calendar skill on the records for this review.
